hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$FILE" ] && [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]] && { python3 -m py_compile "$FILE" 2>&1; conda run -n serverhub ruff format "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; conda run -n serverhub ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; } || true
